Notification access
So XDesk can show the phone\'s notifications on the external screen. They stay in memory only: never stored, never sent anywhere.
On the next page, find XDesk and turn its switch on
Switch greyed out? On the app details page, tap ⋮ at the top right → “Allow restricted settings”
Autostart
Without it, the phone does not let XDesk\'s notification service start, so no notifications come in.
Turn XDesk on in the list on the next page; it is also under Settings › Apps › XDesk
The system has not connected XDesk\'s notification service yet. Turn XDesk\'s switch off and on again.
Do Not Disturb access
So the Do Not Disturb switch on the external screen can set the phone\'s, like the one in Quick Settings.
Notifications
So you can type the pairing code right in XDesk\'s notification, without switching between pages.
While a desktop runs, one notification stays; tap it to come back to XDesk. Works without it too.
Not required: open XDesk in split screen or a floating window and type it on its page
Display over other apps
So the clock can cover the external screen while it is locked.
So this screen can show the launcher. Until then, choose apps on the phone.
On the next page, turn on “Allow display over other apps”
Run commands in Termux
So XDesk can start and end desktops in Termux for you, and list Termux\'s environments.
The system asks you next
Refused before: allow “Run commands in Termux environment” under App details › Permissions › Additional permissions. Or run xdesk start in Termux yourself
Camera
To scan the QR code Sill shows on the Mac. Without it, go back and add the Mac by address.
Allow the camera under App details › Permissions
Shizuku permission
Modify system settings
Only adb on a computer can grant this:\nadb shell settings put global tether_force_usb_functions 1
So XDesk can switch USB tethering to NCM.
Copy command
Accessibility
On the Mac: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility › allow Sill
